name: GL_REPLICATION_JOURNALS
description: This table stores posted journal batch and header information from a source primary ledger when primary balancing segment values are enabled for replication to a target secondary ledger on the Map Primary to Secondary Ledger page. This table also stores the details from the replication process.

columns.name: SOURCE_JE_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Journal entry batch identifier in the source ledger.

columns.name: SOURCE_JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal entry header identifier in the source ledger.

columns.name: SOURCE_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Source ledger identifier for journal replication.

columns.name: SOURCE_COA_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts identifier for the source ledger.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Journal entry source name of the source ledger journal.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Journal entry category name of the source ledger journal.

columns.name: ACTUAL_FLAG
columns.description: Journal amount type of the source ledger journal. Valid values are A for actual and E for encumbrance amounts.

columns.name: PARENT_JE_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the source ledger journal.

columns.name: LEDGER_RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Ledger relationship identifier.

columns.name: JE_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the journal is a reversing journal. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: GL_JE_CONVERSION_SET_ID
columns.description: Source to target ledger journal conversion rules identifier.

columns.name: TARGET_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Target ledger identifier for journal replication.

columns.name: TARGET_JE_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Journal entry batch identifier in the target ledger.

columns.name: TARGET_JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal entry header identifier in the target ledger.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Code that indicates the status of the replication process. Values for replication errors are from lookup type MJE_BATCH_STATUS. Other valid values are I for in process, X for excluded from replication, and R for replicated.

columns.name: REQUESTID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Replication request error messages.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
